deviations.what: The triage report's CI check no longer verifies the issue-type blocks: --check now validates the bucket table and dispositions only, and never makes the org or per-issue type reads. The type blocks are regenerated by a normal (non---check) run and are informational.
deviations.reason: CI's GITHUB_TOKEN is repository-scoped and structurally cannot read organization.issueTypes -- proven in CI, which reported 'could not read the agentculture org's issue-type menu (an ORGANISATION read...)' after the issues:read fix landed and the issue reads started succeeding. The confirmed design (c7/h9) validates type names against the org menu precisely so an unknown name errors instead of counting zero; that validation cannot run under an Actions token at all. Options were a PAT secret, rendering from observed types, a committed menu file, or dropping the type blocks from the CI check; the operator chose the last as the smallest change. Accepted cost, stated plainly: a stale type block in docs/triage/open-issues.md will not be caught by CI.
